notes: Share album: the whole album as one file that opens in any browser, like a real book: closed at the start, and the pages turn. It shows the cover photo in the preview WhatsApp gives, and needs no app to look at
The assistant's little remarks: short, friendly lines, spoken in the voice of the guide videos, during a long session. Off until you choose how often in Settings › AI
All letter shortcuts work with a Hebrew keyboard layout, Undo included
Taking out a page, adding one or moving photos is refused, with a clear message, when it would break a locked spread that has a photo across the fold; new stories never wait for that
Fix: an album with a long burst of photos taken seconds apart could freeze the computer when it opened. This is the important one if 3.7 would not start
Fix: flipping back a page in a shared album looks right
